strings.zh: 我是个吐火的人,{NEWLINE}你能和我交换{CLEAR}电话号码吗？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: I’m a Firebreather. Want to{NEWLINE}trade phone numbers with me?{VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 好！{SCROLL}接电话的时候我是不会吐火的。{CLEAR}经常联系啊！
strings.en: All right!{SCROLL}Don’t worry. I’ll stop breathing fire{NEWLINE}while we’re talking on the phone...{CLEAR}so give me a call sometime!

strings.zh: 果然吐火的人{CLEAR}不招人喜欢啊⋯⋯
strings.en: I knew that us Firebreathers weren’t{NEWLINE}particularly well liked...

strings.zh: 哦？{NEWLINE}你也想来一起吐火吗？{SCROLL}⋯⋯不是？{SCROLL}那是来和我交换{NEWLINE}电话号码的吗？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: Oh!{NEWLINE}Would you like to breathe fire with me?{SCROLL}...Oh, you don’t.{SCROLL}Would you like to exchange phone{NEWLINE}numbers with me after all? {VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 放心吧,{NEWLINE}你不会被烧伤的,{CLEAR}直接跟我面聊吧。
strings.en: It’s all right.{NEWLINE}I promise I won’t burn you, so you can{CLEAR}come talk to me in person.

strings.zh: 貌似我们经常被人给误会。{NEWLINE}因为我常听别人说,{CLEAR}我们喷火的人{CLEAR}会用火焰去虐待精灵。{SCROLL}这是无中生有！{NEWLINE}我们都是用和平常人{CLEAR}一样的训练方式去训练它们的！{CLEAR}{VAR:0100:10},你知道吗？{SCROLL}喷火只是我们的兴趣而已！
strings.en: It seems people often misunderstand{NEWLINE}us.{SCROLL}I keep hearing that we Firebreathers{NEWLINE}use fire to abuse our Pokémon.{SCROLL}That’s totally made up! We train our{NEWLINE}Pokémon just like everyone else does!{CLEAR}Isn’t that right, {VAR:0100:10}?{SCROLL}Breathing fire is just our hobby!

strings.zh: 噗噗噗噗噗噗噗！{SCROLL}厉害吧？{NEWLINE}我发明了一种新的吐火方法！{SCROLL}电话里看不到啊⋯⋯{SCROLL}不说这个了,我昨天抓到{VAR:0100:11}了。{SCROLL}我想以后好好培养它。
strings.en: Buoahhhbobobo!{SCROLL}What do you think?{NEWLINE}I discovered a new technique{CLEAR}for breathing fire!{SCROLL}Well, not like you can tell over{NEWLINE}the phone...{SCROLL}Never mind that. I caught a wild{NEWLINE}{VAR:0100:11} yesterday.{SCROLL}I think I’ll start training it soon.

strings.zh: 你喜欢{VAR:0100:11}吗？{SCROLL}我⋯⋯一般啦,{SCROLL}和一般人一样。
strings.en: Do you like {VAR:0100:11}?{SCROLL}Me... they’re so-so.{SCROLL}Same as anybody, I guess.

strings.zh: 噗噗噗噗噗噗噗！{NEWLINE}今天状态不错！{SCROLL}那就再来和我对战一次怎么样！{NEWLINE}我们可以进行各种切磋,{CLEAR}我在{VAR:0104:3}等你！
strings.en: Buoahhhbobobo!{NEWLINE}Today is a great day!{SCROLL}You should have another battle with me!{NEWLINE}I’m waiting and practicing{CLEAR}on {VAR:0104:3}!
strings.notes: US 0710/9; layout rebalance 2026-10-09 (prompt icons / single-word page)

strings.zh: 我早准备好了在{VAR:0104:3}等你！{CLEAR}你快点来。
strings.en: I’m all ready, and waiting for you on{NEWLINE}{VAR:0104:3}, so hurry up!

strings.zh: 我想你应该知道{NEWLINE}精灵是有很多种属性的吧？{SCROLL}各种属性都有各自的优点和缺点,{CLEAR}所以不能一概而论地说{CLEAR}某种属性是最强的。{SCROLL}尽管如此⋯⋯{SCROLL}但我还是超级喜欢火属性的！{CLEAR}噗噗噗噗噗噗噗！！
strings.en: You know how there are so many{NEWLINE}different types of Pokémon, right?{SCROLL}Each type has good points and bad{NEWLINE}points, so it’s not easy to say which{CLEAR}type is the best.{SCROLL}However...{SCROLL}My choice has to be the Fire type!{CLEAR}Buoahhhbobobo!!

strings.zh: 你知道吗,{NEWLINE}今天是捕虫大会啊！{SCROLL}我是不怎么喜欢虫精灵啦,{CLEAR}不过自然公园{CLEAR}离３５号道路还是蛮近的,{CLEAR}所以我想去看看。
strings.en: Did you know that today’s the{NEWLINE}Bug-Catching Competition?{SCROLL}I’m not that into Bug-type Pokémon,{NEWLINE}but the National Park isn’t that far{CLEAR}from Route 35...{CLEAR}I thought I might go check it out.
